name: dsh-idle-hook
description: Idle/awaiting-human hook for DeepSeek Harness: run a user-configured local script (python/bat/ps1/sh/executable) whenever the model is not running — turn finished, tool approval pending, or a question awaiting an answer — and push the notification wherever you want (macOS/Windows desktop, Bark/ntfy, chat webhooks, NetEase POPO).
